categories.main_business_segments: Hanil Cement Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the manufacturing and sales of cement, remital (dry mortar), and ready-mixed concrete (remicon). The company also engages in construction through its subsidiary Hanil Development Co., Ltd. The revenue composition is approximately 49% from cement, 27% from remital, 17% from remicon, and 8% from other businesses including construction.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes large-scale capital-intensive manufacturing processes for cement production, including clinker production and slag cement manufacturing. It operates multiple production plants equipped with eco-friendly technologies such as ECO power generation using waste heat from clinker production. Research and development focus on raw material development, product quality improvement, cost reduction, and environmentally friendly cement products including low-carbon clinker and carbon capture technologies. The remital and remicon products are developed with patented formulations and production methods to enhance performance and environmental compliance.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Hanil Cement serves primarily domestic construction companies, including large construction firms and ready-mixed concrete companies. Its products are essential for civil engineering, building construction, and social infrastructure projects in South Korea. The remital products are also exported to Asian and Australian markets. The construction segment serves housing, commercial buildings, civil engineering, and landscaping sectors with clients including government agencies and private developers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in South Korea with production plants located in Gangwon-do, Chungcheongbuk-do, Gyeongsang, Jeolla, and metropolitan areas including Seoul and surrounding regions. It has a nationwide distribution network with 20 shipping and storage facilities across key regions. Exports of remital products extend to Asia and Australia. The company’s subsidiaries also operate plants in various domestic locations.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hanil Cement operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer of cement and related building materials. It controls raw material sourcing, production, and distribution of cement, remital, and remicon. The company also operates downstream in construction services through its subsidiary, integrating supply of materials with construction execution.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus includes enhancing product quality and cost competitiveness through continuous R&D in cement and concrete technologies. It prioritizes environmental sustainability by developing low-carbon cement products, carbon capture technologies, and expanding circular economy initiatives such as waste recycling and renewable energy utilization. Hanil Cement is also exploring new growth areas including soil remediation, wastewater treatment, hydrogen gas production, and environmental consulting aligned with green energy and carbon neutrality goals.
categories.revenue_model: Hanil Cement generates revenue primarily through the sale of cement, remital (dry mortar), and ready-mixed concrete products to construction companies and distributors. It also earns income from construction contracts via its subsidiary and from exports of remital products. Payments are typically made in cash or promissory notes, with sales conducted through direct sales and authorized dealers. The company’s revenue is largely domestic with a small portion from exports.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Hanil Cement is a leading cement manufacturer in South Korea, recognized as a top-quality brand with a strong market position. It competes with other domestic cement producers and faces competition in the remicon and remital markets from numerous smaller suppliers. The company maintains competitive advantages through its extensive nationwide production and distribution network, continuous product innovation, and environmental leadership. It has been ranked first in quality satisfaction indices for multiple years and is regarded as one of the most respected companies in the cement industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of December 31, 2023, Hanil Cement reported consolidated total assets of approximately 2.87 trillion KRW and equity of about 1.72 trillion KRW. The company achieved consolidated revenues of 1.8 trillion KRW with an operating profit of 246.5 billion KRW and net income of 177.7 billion KRW in 2023. The company has shown growth in sales and profitability compared to prior years, despite challenges in the construction market. Its debt ratio remains healthy at around 67%. The company continues to invest in eco-friendly technologies and expansion of circular economy businesses.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Hanil Cement emphasizes superior product quality, stable supply through an extensive nationwide network, and environmental sustainability as its key value propositions. It differentiates itself with patented product formulations, such as high-strength and noise-reducing mortars, and by pioneering eco-friendly cement products including low-carbon clinker. The company’s integrated production of cement and secondary products (remital and remicon) ensures consistent quality and supply stability. Its commitment to R&D, customer satisfaction, and ESG initiatives further strengthens its competitive positioning.
